verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS compliance platform like ComplyAdvantage Mesh, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out control. Unrelated settings such as opt-in webhook signing and API credential permissions do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
